mapper.select: SELECT de.province_code provinceId, de.city_code cityId, de.county_code countyId, de.device_code, de.device_name, ord.industry_code, ord.app_ver_code as appVersion, de.town_code town_code FROM vm_order_recorder_devices ord JOIN vm_recorder_device_info_t de ON de.device_code = ord.device_code WHERE de.delete_flag = '0' AND de.province_code != '' AND de.province_code IS NOT NULL AND de.city_code != '' AND de.city_code IS NOT NULL AND de.county_code != '' AND de.county_code IS NOT NULL AND ord.order_code = #{orderCode} and ord.ord_status in (0,1,2) ORDER BY de.province_code, de.city_code, de.county_code, de.town_code
